programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u067/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in out for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in out))
    occupied_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(out) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    groups = []
    for r in occupied_rows:
        if not groups or r > groups[-1][-1] + 1:
            groups.append([r])
        else:
            groups[-1].append(r)
    if len(groups) < 2:
        return out
    # Compare the leading row of each pattern block; extend the shorter one
    # to the rightmost extent of the other using the task's marker color.
    r1, r2 = groups[0][0], groups[1][0]
    ends = [max(c for c, v in enumerate(out[r]) if v != bg) for r in (r1, r2)]
    short_idx = 0 if ends[0] < ends[1] else 1
    target = (r1, r2)[short_idx]
    end = max(ends)
    for c in range(ends[short_idx] + 1, end + 1):
        if out[target][c] == bg:
            out[target][c] = 1
    return out
'''

code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max({v for row in out for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in out))
    occupied = [r for r,row in enumerate(out) if any(v != bg for v in row)]
    groups=[]
    for r in occupied:
        if not groups or r > groups[-1][-1]+1: groups.append([r])
        else: groups[-1].append(r)
    if len(groups)<2: return out
    upper,lower=groups[:2]
    for ru,rl in zip(upper,lower):
        last=max((c for c,v in enumerate(out[rl]) if v!=bg),default=-1)
        # lower pattern is the one-column-right copy of upper; propagate its continuation
        for c in range(last+1,len(out[rl])):
            src=c-1
            if src>=0 and out[ru][src]!=bg:
                out[rl][c]=1
    return out
'''
